title: Modality-specific reactive and predictive responses in the human superior colliculus
title_zh: 人类上丘特定模态的反应性和预测性响应
abstract: Inspired by recent theoretical work emphasizing predictive neural processing, we tested whether a midbrain structure for multimodal sensory integration—the superior colliculus—would show predictive responses to both visual and somatosensory stimulation. A multi-stage experimental design allowed us to test predictive activity in the human superior colliculus while 7-Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) allowed us to map its sensory response across superior colliculus layers (N = 80). As expected from non-human animal work, visual and somatosensory stimulation elicited distinct depth-dependent responses. We also observed a predictive response: these same modality-specific and depth-dependent effects occurred during task periods preceding direct stimulation, when sensorimotor input was identical between visual and somatosensory conditions. Further analyses rule out cross-trial carryover and show corresponding effects in the thalamic sensory nuclei. Here our results confirm that, in humans, the superior colliculus is sensitive to both visual and somatosensory input, and they demonstrate that it carries predictive signals for upcoming sensory events. Chen et al. use 7-Tesla fMRI to show that the human superior colliculus has modality-specific, depth-dependent activity prior to visual or somatosensory events, resembling its response to actual stimulation.
abstract_zh: 受近期强调预测性神经处理的理论工作启发，我们测试了一个负责多模态感官整合的中脑结构——上丘——是否会对视觉和体感刺激产生预测性响应。多阶段实验设计使我们能够在人类上丘中测试预测性活动，同时7特斯拉功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）让我们能够在上丘层中映射其感官响应（N = 80）。正如预期的那样，来自非人类动物研究的工作，视觉和体感刺激引起了分层依赖的不同响应。我们还观察到了预测性响应：在直接刺激期间之前的任务时期，出现了相同的模态特异性和分层效应，此时感官运动输入在视觉和体感条件下是相同的。进一步的分析排除了跨试验携带过，并在感官核丘中显示出相应的效应。我们的结果证实，在人类中，上丘对视觉和体感输入都敏感，并证明它携带即将到来的感官事件的预测信号。Chen等人利用7特斯拉fMRI展示了人类上丘具有模态特异性、分层的活动，这些活动在视觉或体感事件之前出现，类似于对实际刺激的响应。
